name: flowqa
description: Testora — Testing, Without the Complexity. No-code API & UI test automation.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
